title: Finding (IF-17 message · IF-69 blackboard contract · SRS-13 §5 shared schema)
description: A specialist's evidence-backed observation. Published on agent.finding.{agent}; persisted by the orchestrator through swarm.upsert_finding(). Every number in title/summary must come from a tool result (AI-01); the database refuses a Finding without evidence (C-02), from a non-specialist (FR-22) or outside the agent's domain (FR-14).

agent.description: The registered specialist that produced it (FR-22: never the manager)

domain.description: One of the agent's registered domains (FR-14)

scope.description: Where the issue is. plant is mandatory; line/machine/sku/lot identify the issue family (IF-69 §3); shift is informational and never enters the issue key

issue_code.description: family.kind — machine.degradation, quality.defect_rate, material.shortage, lot.quality_history, production.performance_loss … (IF-69 §3)

summary.description: Facts from tool results, with their numbers; the briefing may quote only what is here or in evidence (AC-07)

confidence.description: The agent's own confidence, already discounted for stale data (AI-07)

likelihood_class.description: Scoring factor (IF-70): observed = the condition exists now

horizon.description: Scoring factor (IF-70): when the impact lands

freshness_min.description: Age of the newest data the finding relies on, in minutes (AI-07); > 60 is flagged in the briefing

ref.description: A resolvable reference: telemetry:M-07:bearing_temp:2026-09-03..10, alert:1184, signal:S-241, oee:line1:2026-09-08..10, stock:RAD-500-A, po:PO-2026-004821

recommended_action.description: A recommendation for a human — agents never act (C-03)

impact_estimate.description: e.g. {downtime_risk_h, affected_lines[]} — numbers here may be quoted in the briefing
